title: 1977 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Snake
seo_title: 1977 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Snake (18 February – 6 February 1978)
description: 1977 is the Year of the Fire Snake (Yin, Ding-si), from 18 February 1977 to 6 February 1978. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1977.
lead: Born in 1977? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Snake, but check the date: the 1977 Fire Snake year began on 18 February 1977. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1977: Year of the Fire Snake, from 18 February 1977 to 6 February 1978.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1977 was the Year of the Snake. It began with Lunar New Year on 18 February 1977 and ended on 6 February 1978, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1977 ends in 7, which makes it a Fire year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1977 is a Ding-si year. The same Fire Snake combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1917 before it and 2037 after it.
Lunar New Year 1977 fell on 18 February 1977, so everyone born in January 1977, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Dragon.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Snake guide describes the sign like this: “Wise, intuitive, and elegant. Snakes are deep thinkers who plan carefully before acting.” The usual watch-out: “Can be secretive or prone to overthinking.”

The Fire element adds its own flavour. Fire years bring passion, energy, and boldness. People of this element tend to be dynamic, adventurous, and quick to lead. Read more in our Fire element guide, or the full Year of the Snake page.
Careers often linked with the Snake: finance, research, psychology, strategy.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1977
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Snake's best matches are the Ox, Rooster and Monkey, and its clash sign is the Pig, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Snake, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Snake, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Snake years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1953 (Water Snake); 1965 (Wood Snake); 1989 (Earth Snake); 2001 (Metal Snake). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1977 is the Year of the Snake, a Yin Fire Snake year (Ding-si).
When does the 1977 Year of the Snake start and end?
It starts on 18 February 1977 and ends on 6 February 1978.
I was born in January 1977. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Dragon: Lunar New Year 1977 was on 18 February 1977, so all of January 1977 belongs to the Dragon year.
Fire. 1977 ends in 7, which belongs to Fire, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Snake compatible with?
Traditionally the Ox, Rooster and Monkey. The Snake's clash sign is the Pig.
